title: Crowns and Last Masks
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Depth pass, October 16, 2026. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 640 px as one wall and at 1200 px for the labelled works. Dates and stroke counts come from data/gallery.json; the October 5 and 16, 2022 purchases (the latter 742.5 xDai to the artist plus the board's fee, 750 in all) and the 275 transfers of October 16, 2022 (17:32 to 21:40 UTC) from the Gnosis ledger (curation/research/onchain/); the artist's posts of August 11 and 26 and September 6, 2022 from curation/research/social/x-posts.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 21 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: The last masks. Crowned, packed, and drawn in the dense scribble of the summer, these are the faces that ran alongside the cats and the portraits from August 20 to September 17, 2022. Then, after four weeks of silence, three works on October 15 close the series: the first drawing redrawn, which its title calls a fork; number 300; and the collection piece, #0000. Twenty-one works.

A crown is a zigzag of three or five points on top of the head. It sits on a mask with X eyes, on a profile with a cigarette, on a winged figure, and on the skull of #0000. The three-pointed crown is the mark Jean-Michel Basquiat put on his heads forty years earlier, and the comparison is the gallery's, not the artist's: the artist never named him. But a crown on a skull with its eyes crossed out, drawn fast in scribble over flat color, is a thing Basquiat did, and here it is again on a drawing board on a side chain, drawn by someone who signed nearly every work with a scrawled tag: the year, two N's and xyz.

The series ended on a Saturday and changed hands on a Sunday. On October 15 the artist drew the three last works, and on the morning of October 16, 2022, Jamie Thingelstad bought #0000 for 750 xDai, the highest price any ink in the series had carried. That afternoon, over four hours, the artist sent him the rest: 275 drawings, nearly everything from New Nifty on the Block that was not already in his wallet. The whole wing you have walked through arrived in one afternoon. Watch the first of the three October works: it is the first drawing in the series, drawn again ten months later, and the room's last word on what changed.

chapters.title: Crowns on August 20
chapters.opening: Four masks from the first day of the room, August 20, 2022, all crowned or spiked, drawn alongside the first cats in the first fortnight of the burning.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #235
works.text: A dense face with two spiral eyes in boxes, a long nose and a small mouth, drawn in red, blue and orange line over stripes of every color.
works.caption: A dense face with two boxed spiral eyes and a long nose, in red, blue and orange line over stripes.
works.reading: The stripes run in every direction, vertical at the sides and horizontal across the bottom. The eyes are two boxes with spirals of different sizes, and a black loop at the right is an ear.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #236
works.text: A purple crown with a yellow zigzag sits on a grey mask whose right eye is a red X over a yellow ring and whose left is a box of bars. The mouth is a grille of white teeth in a red box. The body below is a cage of black and yellow lines on a red block, and green and purple bars stand at the edges. It is the clearest crown in the room, drawn on the first morning, August 20, 2022, with the burning nine days old. A crown over a cancelled eye and a grille of teeth: a king who cannot see and will not stop grinning. It is the summer's mask with the one thing added that turns it into a statement.
works.caption: A purple and yellow crown on a grey mask, a red X over one eye, white teeth in red.
works.reading: The crown is drawn in yellow with a purple edge, five points, with a black band under it. The X eye is red over a yellow target with blue around it. The teeth are white blocks with black lines between, in a red box with yellow zigzag below.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #238
works.text: A mask in profile facing left, with a crown of black spikes, a yellow spiral eye and a long grille of white teeth, on orange scribbled with blue.
works.caption: A mask in profile facing left, a crown of black spikes, a yellow spiral eye, a long grille.
works.reading: The spikes are a row of black and yellow points on top of the head. The eye is a yellow ring with a spiral in it and blue lashes. The teeth run out past the face to the left.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #239
works.text: A dense mask with a red X in a round eye and a white ring for the other, a bar of blue across the brow, a mouth of white and black bars, on stripes of orange, blue and purple.
works.caption: A dense mask with a red X in a round eye and a blue bar across its brow, on stripes.
works.reading: The round eye at the left is a black ring with the X inside it. The blue bar runs from the upper left through the eyes. Purple drips hang at the left edge.

chapters.title: Robots and a Sun
chapters.opening: August 22 to 29. A crowned orange mask, a robot in white, a yellow face with a nose, and a sun with an X for an eye, drawn the same day as the frightened old man next door.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #241
works.text: An orange mask with a crest of red spikes, a black spiral eye at the left, a white box eye at the right, and a mouth of white bars, on a ground of yellow and black bars.
works.caption: An orange mask with a crest of red spikes, a black spiral eye and a white box eye, on bars.
works.reading: The spiral is drawn in black rings on red. The box eye has a small spiral inside. The ground is ruled with yellow and black bars like a fence, with two yellow targets at the bottom.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #250
works.text: A robot figure on white, its head a box with two glowing yellow eyes under spiky lids, a wide red mouth of white teeth, and a body of black and white bars with pink and blue inside. Red paint runs down the sides like spilled ink. It is the one mask in the room with a whole body and a white ground, and with the red at the edges it looks like it is standing in something. It was drawn on August 26 and posted at five xDai, the new price after the burn. A robot with lit eyes standing in a red puddle on a white page is the series' most cheerful drawing of a disaster.
works.caption: A robot figure on white with glowing yellow eyes under spiky lids, a wide red mouth of white teeth.
works.reading: The eyes are two yellow discs inside black rings, each with spikes above it like lashes. The mouth is a red oval with a row of white blocks. The body is a cage of bars drawn in black with pink and blue scribble inside.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #259
works.text: A yellow face with a long nose, one eye a ring and the other a spiral, a bar of red across it, and a mouth of white teeth, on green and yellow bars.
works.caption: A yellow face with a long green nose, a ring eye and a spiral eye, a red bar across it.
works.reading: The nose is a long green shape running down the center. The red bar comes in from the left at eye height. The face is drawn in yellow, green and blue line over a painted yellow ground.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #262
works.text: A yellow sun with a face on a red ground: one eye an orange X, the other a black box, a zigzag of white teeth for a mouth, and pale drips running down from the bottom of the sun. Red strokes cross the sun from the left, and two small triangles stand at the bottom like tents. The sun fills most of the square and sits inside a soft white ring, so it glows. On August 11 the artist had written of a journey into the sun and asked who still wanted to come along. Eighteen days later, here is the sun: one eye crossed out, teeth bared, dripping. It was drawn the same day as the frightened old man in the next room. The destination and the traveller, on one Monday.
works.caption: A grinning yellow sun on red, an orange X for one eye, a black box for the other, drips below.
works.reading: The drips are pale pink and white lines running from the sun's chin to the bottom edge. The red strokes that cross the face are drawn in loose horizontal scribble. The white ring around the sun is soft and wide.

chapters.title: September Masks
chapters.opening: September 4 to 17. Eight masks: dense ones with X eyes and teeth, a sparse robot on lavender, a profile with a cigarette, a white oval on black, a winged figure, and a profile lit by a beam. The last of them was the collector's purchase on October 5, with the series ten days from its end.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #269
works.text: A dense mask with a red X in each boxed eye, a crown of yellow bars on top, a mouth of white teeth in a red box, and yellow ovals all around.
works.caption: A dense mask with a red X in each boxed eye and a crown of yellow bars, ringed with ovals.
works.reading: The two X marks are red over pink and blue boxes. The crown is a row of yellow bars with zigzag below. The yellow ovals around the edge are drawn with scribble inside like beads.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #270
works.text: A purple scribble mask with a yellow bar through one eye and a blue cross over the other, two mouths of white teeth, and yellow drips from the top.
works.caption: A purple scribble mask, a yellow bar through one eye, a blue cross over the other, mouths stacked.
works.reading: The two mouths sit one above the other at the lower right, each a box of white teeth. The yellow bar comes in from the left. The ground is purple scribble with yellow loops.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #271
works.text: A mask with a crown of white spikes, a white ring eye and a red X eye, a mouth of white teeth in a red box, on brown with orange bars.
works.caption: A mask crowned with white spikes, one white ring eye, one red X eye, white teeth in red.
works.reading: The crown is a zigzag of white spikes along the top with black between. The ring eye is white with a yellow center and spikes above it. The X eye is red over a dark box.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #273
works.text: A robot mask on lavender drawn in a few lines, a red X in a black ring for one eye, a red bar for the other, a box of white and red bars for a mouth, and thin legs below it like a stand. Forty-one recorded strokes. Set beside the purple crowned mask from August, it is the same arrangement with the scribble taken out: the X, the box and the grille, and nothing else. It was drawn on September 6 and posted at five xDai. After a year of packing every square to the edge, the artist drew the mask in forty strokes and stopped, and it holds. The formula had become a signature that could be written fast.
works.caption: A robot mask on lavender in a few lines, a red X for an eye, standing on thin legs.
works.reading: The X eye sits in a black ring with a white rim. The red bar at the right has white zigzag inside. The mouth is a red box with a yellow bar of teeth. Thin black lines under the mask make legs and a stand. A yellow bar runs along the top.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #274
works.text: A blue mask with two crowned eyes, one a ring and one a box, a wide mouth of white teeth in a red frame, and bars of red and orange at the sides.
works.caption: A blue mask whose eyes each wear a small crown, one a ring and one a box, a wide grin.
works.reading: Each eye has a small crown of spikes above it. The nose is a column of bars between them. The mouth is two rows of white teeth in a red box.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #278
works.text: A profile in pink line on slate, facing right, with a red spiral eye at the left, a cross in a ring at the right, a mouth of white teeth, and a cigarette drawn in white line with smoke at its tip. Blue hair in zigzag runs along the top. Fifty-four strokes. It is the one mask in the room that smokes, and the only one that looks relaxed about anything. A week before the Merge, the series drew a head in profile, in a few lines, taking a drag.
works.caption: A profile in pink line on slate with a red spiral eye, a crossed eye, white teeth and a cigarette.
works.reading: The cigarette comes out of the mouth to the right and ends in a white coil of smoke. The red spiral eye is drawn in rings with a pink box around it. The face is a pink outline with a blue fill in the lower half.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #279
works.text: A dense mask with a red target eye and a dark eye, a mouth of yellow teeth in a pink box, a flower at the lower right, on orange and red bars.
works.caption: A dense mask with a red target eye and a dark eye, yellow teeth in a pink box, a flower.
works.reading: The target eye is red and orange rings at the upper left. The teeth are yellow blocks with white between in a pink frame. The flower at the lower right is purple with a yellow center.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #280
works.text: A white oval mask on black, filled with fine colored scribble, with two ringed eyes, a dark nose, a small mouth and a red ear at the right.
works.caption: A white oval mask on black filled with fine colored scribble, two ringed eyes, a red ear at the right.
works.reading: The scribble inside the oval is tight and many-colored, blue, yellow and pink. The eyes are two rings, one with a yellow pupil. The ear is a red loop of scribble.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #285
works.text: A winged figure with a yellow head and two red X eyes spreads black wings over a ground of brown, yellow and purple, a yellow bar across the bottom, the day before the Merge.
works.caption: A winged figure with a yellow head and two red X eyes spreads black wings over brown and purple.
works.reading: The wings are black with white line over them, and they spread to both edges. The head is a yellow oval with a crown of spikes and two red crosses in white rings. A second face sits in the body below.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #291
works.text: A profile in brown with a beam coming in from the left to a ringed eye, a grille of white teeth, and green and pink line over the face, on brown; the collector bought it on October 5, 2022, for five xDai, eleven days before he bought the whole series.
works.caption: A brown profile, a beam coming in from the left to its ringed eye, a grille of white teeth.
works.reading: The beam is a red and yellow bar with zigzag inside. The face is drawn in black line with green, pink and blue loops over it. The teeth are white blocks in a red box.

chapters.title: October 15
chapters.opening: Four weeks after the last mask, three works on one day close the series, and the next morning the collector bought the last of them and received the rest.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #1 fork
works.text: The first drawing in the series, drawn again. A crowd of heads and raised limbs on cyan, with teeth at every size and a hand with spread fingers, as in December 2021. The colors are the same. The lines are looser and the figures larger, with a pink face at the center and a dark figure at the upper right. A small round badge sits at the lower left, and the title says fork. It was drawn on October 15, 2022, the first of the three that day. The word fork is the one a blockchain uses when a chain splits and goes on in two versions. The artist, who began the year with this crowd, drew it again at the end and called it a fork: the same block, a second time, and the people on it drawn bigger and looser by a hand that had made three hundred drawings since. The original is in the first room of this wing. The two are the series' beginning and its ending, and they are the same picture.
works.caption: The first drawing redrawn: a crowd of toothy heads and raised limbs on cyan, a round badge at the corner.
works.reading: The hand at the upper left has five spread fingers, as in the original. The pink face at the center has a white grin and two ringed eyes. The dark figure at the upper right has a box of teeth. Yellow bars run across the top. Recorded with 300 strokes, and denser than anything else in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #300
works.text: A skull mask in the dark with a glowing yellow eye and a beam coming in from the left, its mouth a grille of white teeth, blue bars along the top like a crown, and coils of green and purple at the sides. Number three hundred, drawn two hours after the fork. The light is the summer's light, from the beam room in May, falling on the summer's mask. Three hundred drawings in three hundred and eleven days, and the three-hundredth is a skull with one eye lit, which is the series looking back at itself: dead, crowned, and still watching.
works.caption: A skull mask in the dark, one eye glowing yellow, a beam from the left, blue bars for a crown.
works.reading: The glow spreads from the right eye over the cheek and down the jaw. The beam is a soft band of orange and yellow from the upper left. The coils at the sides are green and purple loops.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #0000
works.text: The collection piece, an edition of one, drawn last on October 15, 2022, four hours after the fork. A purple skull in profile with a red X for an eye and a row of white teeth, under a crown of orange and red bars, with a yellow sun grinning at the upper right. Green bars stand at the left and yellow ones at the right. Everything the series drew is in it: the crown, the X, the grille, the sun, the beads, the scribble. Nothing else in the room took as many strokes: 448. The artist held it back from the board's usual pricing, as with the Faces in August, and put it up as the key to the series. On the morning of Sunday, October 16, Jamie Thingelstad bought it for 750 xDai, and that afternoon the artist sent 275 drawings to his wallet, one transfer at a time, from half past twelve until nearly five o'clock in Minneapolis. The skull under the crown with the sun grinning over it is the series' last self-portrait, and the day after it was drawn it became the deed to the whole block.
works.caption: A purple skull in profile with a red X eye under a crown of bars, a grinning sun above.
works.reading: The skull is drawn in black and purple with blue line along the jaw and yellow zigzag around the eye. The sun at the upper right has a face with teeth and rays drawn in yellow. The crown is a row of orange and red bars with yellow dots. A row of red teeth runs along the bottom like a second jaw.

closing: The fork of the first drawing and #0000 hang side by side at the end. One is the series' first idea, redrawn. The other is everything the series learned in ten months, packed into a single skull with a crown on it and the sun grinning in the corner. Between them is the whole of New Nifty on the Block, and the morning after they were drawn, the whole of it went to one collector who had been buying it a drawing at a time since May.

collectorDecisions.decision: Collector, 2026-10-16: depth pass. Market, platform, people and the collector may be named; the artist's sourced words may be read for feeling; the Basquiat comparison is the gallery's and is stated as such.
